run_gen_build_yaml: run the python script to generate a YAML build configuration for the c-ares library
gen_ares_build: run the buildconf and configure scripts to generate the c-ares ares_build.h header file
config_platform: get the platform-specific ares_config.h header path for darwin, freebsd, linux, or openbsd
ares_build: get the ares_build.h header path and generate it if the file is missing
summarize_gen_build_yaml: summarize the python script that outputs a YAML dictionary listing c-ares source and header files
